author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing shows the first page when asked for a page below 1
summary: Opening the owner listing with a page number below 1 (zero or negative) renders the error page today. The listing must treat any page below 1 as the first page and answer with the normal listing, HTTP 200.
acceptance_criteria: given a request for the owner listing with page=0, when it is opened, then the response is HTTP 200 and the normal owner listing is shown as the first page
given a request for the owner listing with a negative page number, when it is opened, then the response is HTTP 200 and the normal owner listing is shown as the first page
given a request for the owner listing with page=1 or no page number, when it is opened, then the listing behaves exactly as before
non_goals: a non-numeric page value — not named by the intake; current behavior unchanged
a page number above the last page — not named by the intake; current behavior unchanged
the veterinarian directory's page handling — the intake names only the owner listing
notes: Owner recorded absent (intake line 1, decisions empty); scope taken at the request text, which conflicts with no requirement or Non-Goals row. Observed cause, for the implementer to confirm: the controller passes page-1 straight into the page request, which refuses a negative index, so page<=0 throws and reaches the error page. One behavior, one code surface; one data-driven web-level test whose rows are page=0 and page=-1, asserting HTTP 200, the owners list view, and current page 1. Normalizing the parameter is web-controller binding per docs/architecture-principles.md, tested at the web level per docs/testing-principles.md. Under the batching test the slice ships as one entry despite the small cycle count: it has no sibling. PRD delta: REQ-OWN-005 added to Owner records (narrative, anchor, Done-when bullet, edge case 4); no Non-Goals row touched. Autofix audit: no prd-autofix records in the log.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Covered by docs/architecture-principles.md § Web controller row (line 85): normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding, so clamping page below 1 to 1 belongs in OwnerController, which owns paged owner search (docs/system-design.md § Contracts, OwnerController row; REQ-OWN-005 added there). Cause confirmed by grep (IDE oracle unavailable, weaker basis): processFindForm binds page with default 1 and findPaginatedForOwnersLastName passes page - 1 to PageRequest.of, which refuses a negative index. Normalize once, before the page value reaches the helper and the model, so the listing renders currentPage 1 and pagination links stay consistent. No new type, module, or pattern; OwnerRepository and the domain are untouched.
integration_points: Framework transport: MockMvc in the existing @WebMvcTest(OwnerController.class) class, the sanctioned web-layer harness (docs/testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy)

Repository boundary (OwnerRepository): the existing class-level @MockitoBean stub, a conscious exception per docs/testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy. Reason: every test in the class shares that stub under @WebMvcTest, and swapping in a hand-written double would rewrite the suite beyond this slice. The new test adds no new stub type and no new stubbed method
Entry point binding: unchanged; GET /owners still binds page as a request-scoped int and the search criteria onto the existing Owner form object, no new entry point

risks.risk: Normalizing only the value passed to the helper but not the one put in the model leaves currentPage at 0 or negative in the rendered view
risks.mitigation: Normalize the bound value once at the top of the handler (architecture-principles § Web controller: binding); the test asserts model attribute currentPage equals 1

risks.risk: Paged owner listing scales with owner count; docs/system-design.md has no § Scale and Load section to cite
risks.mitigation: Path unchanged by this slice: fixed page size, one repository page query per request; simplest readable form (a bounds clamp)

notes: Autofix audit: no design-doc-autofix records in the log. Brief gap, not fixed under this covered verdict: docs/system-design.md carries no § Scale and Load section; the first slice adding a data-scaling path should create it. Non-goals respected: non-numeric page values, pages above the last page, and the vet listing's identical page - 1 pattern stay unchanged.

author: security-reviewer
approved_aspects: Input validation: the request-supplied `page` is clamped at OwnerController.java:97 (`int page = Math.max(requestedPage, 1);`) before it reaches `PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize)`, so page 0 and negative pages no longer raise IllegalArgumentException into the error page that renders exception text (system-design.md risk row for REQ-SYS-002). This adds a control and weakens none.

Upper bound unchanged and safe: `int` binding at OwnerController.java:95 (`@RequestParam(name = "page", defaultValue = "1") int requestedPage`) rejects non-integer and out-of-range text with a 400 type-mismatch before the handler runs; a large page yields an empty Spring Data page (offset computed as long), not unbounded allocation, since page size stays fixed at 5.

No new sink: `currentPage` echoed into the model is the clamped int, rendered through Thymeleaf default escaping; no string interpolation, query construction, shell, file, or deserialization path added in the diff (python3 scripts/changeset.py read in full).
Binding scope unchanged: the `Owner owner` model attribute on the search handler is pre-existing and the diff adds no bound field; no auth, ownership, validation, or escaping check removed.
No secrets in the diff: the four changed files (docs/prd.md, docs/system-design.md, OwnerController.java, OwnerControllerTests.java) add no credential, token, or connection string.

Supply chain: no dependency change in this slice. No NVD scan run (dependencyCheckAnalyze not configured; listed under docs/security-principles.md § Standing Gaps). Resolved versions: Spring Boot 4.1.2 (build.gradle:5), tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind 3.1.7 (./gradlew dependencies runtimeClasspath).

Observed, outside slice scope: VetController.java:45 (`public String showVetList(@RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") int page, Model model)`) still passes an unclamped page to `PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize)`; this is pre-existing, not extended by this change, and the REQ-OWN-005 bullets name only the owner listing. The exception message it surfaces carries no sensitive value.

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owner listing page below 1 to the first page

blast_radius.note: One prod hunk in OwnerController.processFindForm, one new parameterized test, and two doc edits in the PRD owner block and the contracts row; no sensitive paths. The security-surface path is the same controller and was covered by the full battery.

semantic_surprise.note: The diff does what it claims. Math.max(requestedPage, 1) runs before the clamped page feeds both PageRequest.of(page - 1, 5) and the currentPage model attribute. The @RequestParam name is pinned to "page", so the rename does not change binding. Paths for page >= 1, the single-result redirect, and the empty-result paths are unchanged.

test_adequacy.note: The parameterized MockMvc test drives page 0 and -1 and asserts 200, the list view, and currentPage == 1. Without the clamp, PageRequest.of throws before the stubbed repository is reached, so the test fails against the old code. It does not check which Pageable reaches the repository, but currentPage shares the same variable.

reviewer_hedging.note: All four dispatched reviewers approved with no findings. I spot-checked two citations and both resolve: architecture-principles.md:85 places parameter normalization in the controller, and VetController.java:45 matches. The unconfigured NVD scan is a recorded standing gap. The security reviewer also noted the same unclamped page in VetController; that is pre-existing and outside this slice, not a reservation about this change.

scope_deviation.note: Zero design revisions, consultations, and build retries. The change covers exactly the reported /owners page-below-1 bug and its PRD bullet and edge case. VetController's sibling defect was deliberately left untouched.

rationale: A one-line clamp in the owner search handler. The new test fails against the old code, and the reviewers approved cleanly with citations that check out. A glance at the OwnerController hunk confirms it. The human may want a follow-up slice for the identical unclamped page in VetController.showVetList.
